probes.name: during_replace_manual_calculate
probes.macro:
Function Probe() As String
Application.Calculation = xlCalculationManual
Dim ws As Worksheet, part As Object
Set ws = Worksheets.Add
Set part = ws.Parent.VBProject.VBComponents.Add(1)
part.Name = "UserCode"
part.CodeModule.AddFromString "Function MyCalc(value As Double) As Double" & vbCrLf & "MyCalc = value * 2" & vbCrLf & "End Function"
ws.Range("A1").Value = 3
ws.Range("B1").Formula = "=MyCalc(A1)"
ws.Range("C1").Formula = "=B1+1"
Application.Calculate

Probe = ws.Range("B1").Text & ":" & ws.Range("C1").Text
part.CodeModule.ReplaceLine 2, "MyCalc = value * 3"

Probe = Probe & "|" & ws.Range("B1").Text & ":" & ws.Range("C1").Text
End Function
